environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. The internal GraphQL backend (Hasura) has no query depth limiting or introspection disabled. ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 to the container on port 8000. No request filtering or query analysis is applied at any layer. The CDN scripts referenced in the dashboard HTML are served without integrity verification enforcement (browser SRI is present in HTML but the CDN serves whatever content is at that path).

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB, default listener rules, no WAF attached
config.graphql_backend: Hasura v2.28 with admin secret, introspection enabled, no query depth limit
config.network: VPC with public subnet, ALB -> container direct
config.cdn: CloudFront distribution serving static assets, no origin integrity validation
